$comment: Registry of SAP systems available to this workspace.
NON-SECRET metadata only. Passwords and tokens live in .claude/settings.local.json
and are referenced here by environment-variable NAME via 'passwordEnvVar'.
After editing this file run: pwsh -File scripts/sync-sap-systems.ps1
See docs/sap-systems.md for the full workflow.
Drives SAP GUI for Windows through the SAP GUI Scripting COM API
(kts982/mcp-sap-gui). 'logonDescription' MUST match the entry name in
SAP Logon Pad exactly - it is the argument to sap_connect.
Reuses adt.user / adt.passwordEnvVar / client / language above, so there
is no second credential to maintain.
Set readOnly=true to disable every mutating tool, or add
'allowedTransactions': ["MM03","VA03"] to restrict to a whitelist.
The server's own blocklist (SU01, PFCG, SE16N, SM30-style admin tcodes)
applies regardless.

systems.label: TFS India S/4HANA Development (DS4, client 100)
$comment: Mirrors the VS Code ADT destination 'DS4_100_TFSIN' (~/.adtls/destinations.json).
UNVERIFIED: adt.url is a placeholder derived from the RFC application server
and the default ICM HTTPS port for instance 00. The host was unreachable when
